metadata.day_classification_rule: Malaysian operating week: Mon–Fri = Weekday, Sat–Sun = Weekend
metadata.excluded_od_services_note: KTM ETS, KTM Komuter Utara, and Shuttle Tebrau do not publish paired OD matrices in this upper OD view and are covered separately in Panel 1 — Station Demand Intelligence.
metadata.admin_exclusion_policy: Non-physical administrative/transaction codes ('Penalty', 'Unknown', 'A0') appearing on either origin OR destination are excluded from physical OD volume, unique OD pairs, rankings, distance averages, heatmaps, and hourly profiles without double-counting dual-admin records (e.g., 18,847 deduplicated KTMB Komuter admin trips excluded from 7,405,913 source total -> 7,387,066 physical OD trips).
metadata.distance_methodology: Trip-weighted straight-line Haversine distance (km, R=6,371 km) calculated over ALL eligible physical OD pairs with verified station coordinates; non-physical codes ('Penalty', 'Unknown') excluded cleanly from both numerator and denominator.

shah_alam_discrepancy.note: All 20 Shah Alam Line (SA) stations appear across 324 calendar days in rapidrail_2026_daily.csv. Jan 1–Jul 31 record 0 paid AFC gate OD trips (overlapping early June 29 launch / free trials recorded in headline series), while Aug 1–Nov 20 record 3,265,221 paid origin trips matching Module 4's verified figure. Previous Module 2 missed SA solely because Top-20 pair filtering dropped lower-volume corridors.

weekday_hour_heatmap.note: Rapid Rail data is daily-resolution only; no hourly heatmap available.
